snippet.title: Ninja Gaiden 4 - Official Announcement Trailer (4K) | Xbox Developer Direct 2025
snippet.description: After more than 10 years comes a new mainline Ninja Gaiden from PlatinumGames, featuring a new Master Ninja protagonist to take on the brutal, bloody chaos in an abandoned Tokyo, coming fall 2025.
